name: rip-tv-time
description: A self-hostable clone of TV Time to read and browse your exported watch history.

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute rip_tv_time --local --file=./schema.sql && npm run db:upgrade:local
scripts.db:upgrade:local: wrangler d1 execute rip_tv_time --local --command "ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN avatar_url TEXT" ; wrangler d1 execute rip_tv_time --local --command "ALTER TABLE titles ADD COLUMN original_name TEXT" ; wrangler d1 execute rip_tv_time --local --command "ALTER TABLE watched_episodes ADD COLUMN watched INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1" ; wrangler d1 execute rip_tv_time --local --command "ALTER TABLE titles ADD COLUMN manual_match INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0" ; true
scripts.db:upgrade:remote: wrangler d1 execute rip_tv_time --remote --command "ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN avatar_url TEXT" ; wrangler d1 execute rip_tv_time --remote --command "ALTER TABLE titles ADD COLUMN original_name TEXT" ; wrangler d1 execute rip_tv_time --remote --command "ALTER TABLE watched_episodes ADD COLUMN watched INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1" ; wrangler d1 execute rip_tv_time --remote --command "ALTER TABLE titles ADD COLUMN manual_match INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0" ; true
scripts.db:reset:local: wrangler d1 execute rip_tv_time --local --command "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS watched_episodes; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS library; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS titles; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS sessions; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS auth_tokens; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS users; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS app_settings;" && npm run db:migrate:local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 execute rip_tv_time --remote --file=./schema.sql && npm run db:upgrade:remote
